title: Informational remittance for an unassigned claim on one side only
notes: The provider did not accept assignment (837 CLM07 C). The MAC-processed file reports the claim under LX*0 with MA28 and CLP04 0 (OA*100 for the amount paid to the beneficiary; the adjustment coding is illustrative); the vendor-processed file has no informational claim. Follows the rule-gap cause where one side does not produce the informational remittance.
